name: Amritsar

queries.query: Amritsar official cadastral parcel map land records Punjab India jamabandi bhunaksha GIS official
queries.scope: Find official local cadastral registry/map evidence and test anonymous parcel geometry access.
queries.result: Punjab’s official viewer exposes public parcel lookup routes. At the WUP city point, the Amritsar-1 central hierarchy resolves to a patwar with no map-backed village entries; nearby unbacked urban villages are marked hasData=false. No exact point parcel geometry was returned or retained.
